image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a white Apple iPod Classic resting on top of its original packaging. The device features a glossy white front face with a color LCD screen at the top displaying a music interface and a circular click wheel below. The casing has rounded corners and visible metallic trim on the sides. To the right, part of the product box is visible, showing line-art illustrations of the device and text.

artifact_observations.location: Product packaging on the right side
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the box illustration is illegible scribbles rather than crisp typography. While common in AI generations, it is noticeable upon inspection.
The icons on the click wheel (Menu, Play/Pause, etc.) are faint and lack the sharp contrast and precise geometry found in real product photography. They appear slightly 'melted' into the surface.
The UI elements on the screen do not perfectly align with the perspective angle of the device itself, appearing slightly flat against the angled surface.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific model generation (Classic vs Nano vs Mini) and verify brand authenticity markers.
To analyze the legibility and structure of the text on the box, which showed signs of gibberish.
To check for edge bleeding between the white faceplate and the metallic rim, ensuring structural continuity.
To assess global lighting consistency and detect subtle texture smearing on reflective surfaces.

focus_areas: Legibility and geometric correctness of text on the packaging box.
Sharpness and accuracy of the click wheel icons and labels.
Boundary integrity between the white front panel and the metal chassis.
Realism of screen reflections and UI perspective alignment.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the box; AI often fails to render small print correctly. Also, scrutinize the click wheel icons—are they symmetrical and correctly placed? Check if the reflection on the screen matches the ambient lighting implied by the highlights on the casing.
